facts: WalnutPi is a headless Debian Linux device used as a portable AI terminal.
The current primary workflow is Web preview -> sync LVGL screen -> verify WalnutPi framebuffer evidence.
The default project checkout on the device is /home/pi/projects/WalnutPi.
The small screen target is /dev/fb0, 480x320, RGB565, LVGL fbdev.
Beginner-facing states should stay simple: 未同步, 同步中, 已同步到核桃派, 同步失败.
preferences: Answer in concise Chinese by default.

forbidden: Do not store API keys, Wi-Fi passwords, SSH passwords, tokens, private keys, or logs as memory.
